entries.literalBodyMarkdown: Input a safe desired biological function. Compile toward molecular mechanisms, cells, tissues, experiments, and manufacturing pathways. Biology begins to resemble programmable engineering.

Discover the smallest programmable control layer capable of orchestrating cellular behavior across many cell types. A universal interface to living machinery would produce an enormous biotechnology tree.
Instead of modifying existing organisms gene by gene, design living systems from functional specifications, constrained by safety and biology.
Organisms self-assemble from developmental rules. Learn to program those rules rather than micromanaging final structure. Manufacturing could become **growth**.
Discover universal principles through which simple local rules generate complex stable form. Apply them across biology, robotics, materials, architecture, and computation.
Factories currently assemble products. Build production systems where products increasingly assemble themselves from local interactions.
Machines are manufactured to completion. Invent machines whose architecture grows, adapts, repairs, and reorganizes itself after deployment.
Create technologies designed around continuous regeneration rather than maintenance. Buildings, machines, infrastructures, and networks that heal damage before failure.
Give complex technology distributed anomaly detection, memory, adaptive response, and learned defense inspired by biological immunity.

Organisms continuously exchange matter and energy with their environment. Design machines and cities that dynamically recycle, repair, allocate, and renew resources instead of consuming and discarding them.
A city becomes an adaptive organism whose transportation, energy, buildings, services, water, waste, production, and governance continuously respond to conditions.
Roads, grids, networks, factories, and logistics systems propose and test their own improvements under human constitutional constraints.
Create a planet-scale observational fabric measuring ecological, industrial, energetic, infrastructural, and scientific state with sufficient fidelity for coordinated stewardship.
Fuse models of climate, ecology, resources, infrastructure, population, economics, and technology into an evolving, falsifiable model of planetary systems.
Detect cascading planetary risks and identify leverage points before interventions become expensive or irreversible.
Given any abundant raw input, find processes turning it into the useful materials civilization needs. The objective is to make **resource scarcity increasingly substrate-independent**.
Design economically viable pathways for decomposing complex waste back into reusable elemental or molecular building blocks.
Treat physical matter the way networks treat packets. Materials are characterized, transformed, and routed dynamically to whatever production process values them most.
Search chemical and structural possibility space directly for target behaviors rather than searching known materials catalogs.
Input desired macroscopic properties. Compile candidate molecular compositions, microstructures, fabrication methods, and experiments.
Instead of searching for materials with known useful properties, search for **material properties nobody has thought to request**.
Design matter whose function comes primarily from geometry and organization rather than chemistry. Eventually architecture itself becomes a programmable material property.
Discover a manufacturable unit of matter that can reversibly reorganize into many forms under computation. Physical objects start behaving like software.
Network programmable matter units so physical structure becomes distributed, addressable, updateable, and reconfigurable.
Today computation is rented from clouds. Imagine requesting temporary physical capability: fabrication, laboratory work, robotics, materials, energy, logistics, instrumentation, all behind APIs.
Every compatible machine tool, lab, robot, and fabrication system can dynamically join a global manufacturing fabric. Designs route themselves to available production capacity.
Input a product specification. Output not merely the product design but the factory architecture required to produce it economically.
A generalized manufacturing seed capable of producing increasingly sophisticated manufacturing equipment. Industrial capacity becomes recursively expandable.
Determine the minimum machine set required to bootstrap progressively larger portions of modern industry from raw materials.
Generalize that to energy, manufacturing, agriculture, medicine, computation, communication, and education. A compact seed capable of building upward toward technological civilization.
Not one self-replicating robot. A cooperative ecosystem of machines where different units mine, refine, fabricate, maintain, transport, and reproduce one another's components.
Search every physically plausible conversion mechanism for energy-generation pathways humanity has overlooked.
Search for matter architectures optimized specifically for energy capture, storage, conversion, transmission, and dissipation.
Make energy generation, storage, trading, routing, and consumption dynamically interoperable at extremely fine granularity.
Civilization wastes enormous quantities of usable energy gradients. Build systems that continuously discover and harvest otherwise lost exergy throughout industrial processes.
Give it desired transformation X → Y. It searches for physically possible pathways minimizing entropy production, waste, energy cost, and material complexity.
Design infrastructure where waste heat from one process becomes input energy for another until industrial ecosystems approach closed energetic symbiosis.
Search nature for unexplored information-processing phenomena rather than assuming computation means silicon logic gates.
Instead of simulating a physical process digitally, engineer the physical process itself to solve the corresponding mathematical problem.
Compile mathematical problems into physical systems whose natural evolution computes the solution.
A material whose geometry causes it to perform useful computation while interacting with its environment.
Let optical, chemical, mechanical, biological, quantum, topological, and unknown substrates compete on classes of problems. Computing becomes an evolutionary ecosystem of physical mechanisms.

Search for deep correspondences between algorithmic operations and naturally occurring physical transformations. Entire classes of computations might be obtainable “for free” from properly arranged physics.
Seek deeper operational laws connecting information processing and physical energy. If new exploitable relationships exist, they could reshape computing architecture.
Identify fundamental computational primitives independent of implementation substrate, then map which physical systems instantiate each primitive most efficiently.
Search not merely implementations but fundamentally new algorithmic paradigms comparable to recursion, dynamic programming, Fourier methods, backpropagation, or Monte Carlo.
Search mathematical structure around computational complexity for overlooked distinctions or exploitable problem classes.
Instead of solving hard problems directly, invent transformations that map them into completely different domains where they become easy.
Discover representations allowing a problem requiring astronomical work in one space to collapse into modest work in another.

Identify operations civilization performs sequentially only because history built them that way. Re-architect entire workflows so dependencies collapse and time-to-result shrinks by orders of magnitude.
Search architectures where computation emerges asynchronously from local interactions rather than centralized timing assumptions.
Ask whether some tasks can be performed by dynamics where information is encoded entirely in current state trajectories rather than stored representations.
Find problems whose answers can be obtained by constructing the correct physical boundary conditions and letting reality settle into the solution.
Input semantic intent. Determine the minimum signal necessary for another intelligence to reconstruct the intended meaning.
Compress not strings or video but **conceptual state**. If sufficiently powerful, education, collaboration, and human-machine communication transform.
Networked systems exchange machine-verifiable meaning, causality, provenance, uncertainty, rights, and consequences rather than mostly documents and packets.
Define a primitive capable of carrying a claim plus evidence, provenance, assumptions, uncertainty, dependencies, applicability, falsifiers, and update history.
A universal protocol for moving structured knowledge between humans, machines, labs, institutions, and software without losing meaning or provenance.
Every new fact automatically reaches the systems whose beliefs, plans, or designs depend on it.
When an important fact changes, every dependent model, explanation, plan, curriculum, simulation, and policy can be identified and reconsidered.
Validated discoveries instantly propagate into relevant models, experiments, engineering systems, and research agendas worldwide.
Experiments are represented in machine-executable protocols so independent laboratories can automatically reproduce important results.
Robotic laboratories worldwide become addressable nodes in one experimental network. Science gains planetary experimental parallelism.
Researchers submit hypotheses as easily as developers submit cloud jobs. Automated infrastructure chooses labs, performs experiments, validates results, and returns evidence.
`test(hypothesis)` becomes an actual programmable interface backed by models, simulations, literature, robotics, laboratories, replication, and statistical inference.
`invent(specification)` orchestrates mathematics, science, engineering, fabrication, simulation, testing, economics, and iteration.
A standardized interface to safely compose institutions, infrastructure, production, learning, scientific discovery, and governance mechanisms.
Translate abstract human values into measurable constraints, institutional mechanisms, reversible experiments, and explicit unresolved ambiguities without pretending values reduce to a single number.
Before consequential interventions, simulate effects on many stakeholders, assumptions, and future states, exposing hidden trade-offs rather than collapsing ethics into one metric.
Convert abstract rights into enforceable constraints across software, markets, institutions, AI agents, robots, and data systems.
Develop a formal science describing how permission, delegation, revocation, consent, and responsibility propagate through complex human-machine systems.
A universal machine-readable way for systems to understand what actions are authorized, by whom, for how long, over what data, with what revocation conditions.
Given a complex mission, construct the safest possible authority graph such that every agent receives only the minimum permissions required.
Detect cascading systemic failures, malicious capture, epistemic poisoning, infrastructure fragility, and runaway mechanisms across society before they metastasize.
Input a system and threat model. Generate redundancy, graceful degradation, fallback paths, recovery procedures, diversity, and antifragile learning.
Simulate severe failure scenarios across interconnected systems to identify surprisingly cheap interventions that prevent cascading collapse.
Deliberately generate plausible events outside conventional forecasting distributions. The goal is not accurate prediction but making systems less surprised by entire classes of surprise.

Integrate anomaly mining, assumption auditing, cross-domain contradictions, outlier detection, and open-ended simulation into a permanent institution devoted solely to finding what civilization does not know it does not know.

Instead of mapping knowledge, map the shape of missing knowledge. Distinguish unexplored regions, contradictory regions, unmeasurable regions, conceptually inaccessible regions, and falsely settled regions.
Infer the existence of unknown concepts indirectly from patterns of unexplained failures, just as dark matter was inferred from gravitational effects.
When many theories fail in correlated ways, infer the invisible structure that could explain their shared error.
Search for phenomena where current models repeatedly need arbitrary corrections. Hypothesize latent variables that make those corrections disappear.
Find sets of problems scattered across established fields that become coherent if treated as one new science.
Find scientific questions whose main limitation is not theory but inability to measure the relevant state.
Identify domains where empirical regularities appear too complicated because humanity lacks the mathematical language in which they simplify.
Identify data structures humans repeatedly misunderstand because our perceptual systems cannot intuit them, then invent an artificial sense optimized for that structure.
Observe systematic reasoning failures across humans and AIs and infer that an entire reasoning primitive may be absent.
Detect valuable exchanges or collaborations that repeatedly fail because no mechanism exists to coordinate them. Then invent the missing institution.
Find latent supply and demand that cannot meet because trust, pricing, measurement, transaction costs, or rights are unresolved.
